description: Median weekly rent of new bonds lodged in the latest quarter, all dwellings together, with the bond count and the change on a year before, for one state per call: NSW by postcode or council (NSW Department of Communities and Justice), QLD by suburb or council (Residential Tenancies Authority), WA by locality (calculated by DwellDelta from the Government of Western Australia's bond records). Each CC BY 4.0. With no area or council it gives the state's own figure. New-bond medians, not advertised rents; never add or compare the states as one series; quote the quarter, the source line and the limits. Victoria is in vic_rents. For NSW and QLD, give dwelling_type or bedrooms (or both) for the publisher's figure for that kind of home instead - a two-bedroom unit, a three-bedroom house. Only combinations the publisher reports are answered: one with no published median is said to have none, and must not be filled from another area or from the all-dwellings figure. Many such figures rest on few bonds. WA has no figures by dwelling type or bedrooms.

area.description: NSW: a four-digit postcode (a suburb name returns its postcodes to try). QLD: a suburb. WA: a locality. Part of a suburb or locality name works

bedrooms.description: NSW and QLD only: a number of bedrooms, as '2' or '2 bedrooms'. NSW also has Bedsitter, and 4 means DCJ's '4 or more Bedrooms'; a number above 4 is answered under that label too, and the answer says it is not for that number alone. QLD: the RTA publishes flats of 1 to 3, houses of 2 to 4 and town houses of 2 to 3, and does not define its labels - reading the number as bedrooms is DwellDelta's. A plus means 'or more', which only DCJ's 4 has: '3+', and any 'N+' for QLD, is refused, not answered as exactly N. Without dwelling_type, every type the publisher reports at that size is given

council.description: A council (NSW or QLD), or part of its name

dwelling_type.description: NSW and QLD only. NSW (DCJ's labels): House, Townhouse, Flat/Unit, Other. QLD (the RTA's): Flat, House, Townhouse. 'unit' and 'apartment' are read as flat/unit. Without bedrooms, every size the publisher reports for that type is given

state.description: NSW, QLD or WA - one state per call

name: area_rents
title: NSW, Queensland and WA rents by postcode, suburb or locality
